item.title: Matunuck Atelier Opens Restaurant While Awaiting Market
item.description: The new Matunuck Atelier location offers many Matunuck Oyster Bar menu favorites as well as a greater emphasis on ceviche, crudo and sushi and fresh, made-on-site pasta. Plus, they plan to open a market with fish, shellfish, cheese, fresh pasta and sandwiches available for purchase.
